meaning: a * b, low n trits (wrapping modulo 3^n)
name: mul

meaning: -1, 0 or +1 as a two's complement integer of the register width, by comparing values; 2 if either operand is invalid
name: cmp

meaning: a times 3^k modulo 3^n, k = b modulo the register width in bits; k >= n gives 0
name: shl

meaning: drop the low k trits (division by 3^k rounding to nearest), k = b modulo the register width in bits; k >= n gives 0
name: shr

meaning: a read as a two's complement integer of the register width, wrapped modulo 3^n into range
name: from_int

meaning: the value as a two's complement integer of the register width (always representable); invalid gives the most negative integer
name: to_int
